DEFAULT rcParams
+ dm.style.use("scientific")

Exactly five rcParam shifts make the difference:

font.family DejaVu SansRoboto
font.weight normal (400)light (300)
axes.spines box (4 sides)all visible, thinner
lines.linewidth 1.5 pt0.5 pt
layout tight_layout()dm.simple_layout(fig)
prop_cycle C0..C9 (saturated)oc.teal7 / orange7
Same data, same matplotlib calls. The diff above is the entire delta — applied by dm.style.use("scientific") plus dm.simple_layout(fig). No new plotting API to learn.
